definitions.explanation: The act of agreeing with someone or giving permission; sharing the same opinion.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{意見|いけん}に{同意|どうい}する。
{同意|どうい}なしにデータを{使用|しよう}することはできない。
examples.english: Data cannot be used without consent.

examples.japanese: {同意|どうい}を{得|え}てから{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}ぶ。
examples.english: We will sign the contract after obtaining consent.

notes:
{同意|どうい} means both "agreement" (sharing the same opinion) and "consent" (giving permission). Composed of {同|どう} (same) + {意|い} (intention).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同意|どうい}する: to agree, to consent
- {同意|どうい}を{得|え}る: to obtain consent
- {同意|どうい}{書|しょ}: consent form
- {同意|どうい}なく: without consent
- 〜に{同意|どうい}する: to agree to/with ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {合意|ごうい}: mutual agreement (emphasizes both parties agreeing together)
- {賛成|さんせい}: approval, support (for a proposal or plan)
- {承諾|しょうだく}: consent, acceptance (responding to a request — more formal)
- {同感|どうかん}: sharing the same feeling ("I feel the same way")

REGISTER:
Neutral to formal. {同意|どうい}{書|しょ} (consent form) is common in medical and legal contexts.
